title: Abanyamuryango
description: Abantu bose bari muri iyi koperative, n'ibyo umwe umwe yatanze.
tableCaption: Abanyamuryango b'iyi koperative, hamwe na nimero zabo, imiterere, aho batuye n'itariki yinjiye.
loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kuzana urutonde rw'abanyamuryango. Reba interineti hanyuma ugerageze.

notFound.title: Uwo munyamuryango ntabonetse
notFound.body: Ushobora kuba wafunguye umurongo ushaje, cyangwa uwo muntu ari mu yindi koperative.

stats.withoutPhoneHint: Aba banyamuryango ntibashobora kugezwaho ubutumwa kuri SMS, bagomba kumenyeshwa ubundi buryo.
stats.wholeRegister: Iyi mibare ireba urutonde rwose, atari abagaragara mu rutonde rwungurujwe.

search.label: Shakisha abanyamuryango
search.placeholder: Izina, nimero y'umunyamuryango cyangwa nimero ya telefone

sort.label: Gutondeka
sort.lastName: Izina ry'umuryango, kuva kuri A kugera kuri Z
sort.-lastName: Izina ry'umuryango, kuva kuri Z kugera kuri A

empty.title: Nta munyamuryango uracyanditswe
empty.body: Andika umunyamuryango wa mbere utangire urutonde. Izina ryonyine rirahagije.

emptyFiltered.title: Nta munyamuryango uhuye n'ibyo washakaga
emptyFiltered.body: Gerageza indi miterere cyangwa indi nshingano, cyangwa ukureho ibyungurujwe urebe bose.

pagination.summary: Hagaragara kuva ku {{from}} kugeza ku {{to}} muri {{total}} b'abanyamuryango

export.failed: Ntitwashoboye gukora iyo dosiye. Reba interineti hanyuma ugerageze.

form.createDescription: Izina ribanza n'izina ry'umuryango ni byo bisabwa gusa. Ibindi byose bishobora kwandikwa nyuma mu biro.
form.editDescription: Hindura ibyo uzi. Iyo usize umwanya ubusa, ibyari byanditswe birakurwaho.

fields.nationalIdHint: Imibare cumi n'itandatu, nk'iyanditse ku ndangamuntu.
fields.phoneHint: Abanyamuryango benshi nta telefone bafite. Sige umwanya ubusa iyo nta yo ihari.
fields.notesHint: Ikintu cyose ibiro bikwiye kwibuka kuri uyu munyamuryango.

fieldErrors.nationalId: Nimero y'indangamuntu igizwe n'imibare cumi n'itandatu.
fieldErrors.phone: Iyo si nimero ya telefone yo mu Rwanda. Sige umwanya ubusa niba nta yo ihari.

statusDialog.title: Guhindura imiterere ya {{name}}
statusDialog.description: Umunyamuryango ntasibwa na rimwe. Amakuru ye n'amateka y'imisanzu ye abaho iteka mu bitabo.
statusDialog.reasonHint: Ibikwa hamwe n'amakuru ye, kugira ngo impinduka ishobore gusobanurwa nyuma.
statusDialog.exitedOnHint: Urutonde rugumana igihe yamaze ari umunyamuryango.

confirmStatus.title: Shyira {{name}} kuri {{status}}?
confirmStatus.body: Ntazongera kubarwa nk'umunyamuryango ukora kuva ubu. Ibyanditswe byose bikomeza kuba uko byari, kandi ushobora kumusubizaho igihe icyo ari cyo.

profile.detailsDescription: Ibyo ibiro bifite kuri uyu munyamuryango.

summary.withheld: Inshingano yawe ntiyemerera kureba iyi mibare

timeline.title: Amateka
timeline.description: Ibyose byanditswe kuri uyu munyamuryango, ibya vuba mbere.
timeline.emptyBody: Andika umusanzu cyangwa umugabane, bizagaragara hano n'itariki yabyo.

contributions.title: Imisanzu
contributions.description: Amafaranga uyu munyamuryango yatanze mu koperative.
contributions.caption: Imisanzu y'uyu munyamuryango, hamwe n'itariki, ubwoko, ingano n'uburyo bw'ubwishyu.
contributions.emptyBody: Iyo uyu munyamuryango yishyuye amafaranga yo kwinjira, ubwizigame cyangwa umusanzu, wandike hano kugira ngo ibitabo bihure n'amafaranga.
contributions.withheld: Inshingano yawe ntirebana n'imisanzu, ni yo mpamvu uru rutonde rutagaragara.

shares.title: Imigabane
shares.description: Imigabane uyu munyamuryango afite mu koperative.
shares.caption: Uko imigabane y'uyu munyamuryango yagenze, hamwe n'itariki, ubwoko, ingano n'agaciro.
shares.emptyBody: Uyu munyamuryango ntaragira imigabane. Kugura umugabane bwandikirwa ku rupapuro rw'imigabane.
shares.withheld: Inshingano yawe ntirebana n'imigabane, ni yo mpamvu uru rutonde rutagaragara.
shares.cancelConsequence: Ikinyuranyo kiguma mu gitabo n'impamvu utanze, kandi amafaranga yinjiye yo kugura asubizwa aho gukurwaho. Nta kintu gisibwa.
shares.reasonHint: Umunyamuryango ashobora kubibaza nyuma y'imyaka, bityo vuga icyari kitagenze neza.

record.title: Andika ikinyuranyo cy'imigabane
record.counterpartyHint: Kwimura bigira impande ebyiri, iyi ni indi ruhande.
record.chooseMember: Shakisha ku izina cyangwa inomero y'umunyamuryango
record.categoryHint: Kugura imigabane bishyira amafaranga muri koperative, bityo bigomba kugaragara mu bitabo.
record.noCategories: Nta cyiciro cy'amafaranga yinjira cyarashyirwaho, bityo kugura ntibishobora kwandikwa. Banza ushyireho kimwe muri Amafaranga.

contributionDialog.title: Kwandika umusanzu
contributionDialog.description: Kuri {{name}}, {{code}}. Amafaranga yandikwa mu bitabo bya koperative icyarimwe.
contributionDialog.noCategories: Nta byiciro by'amafaranga yinjira biracyashyizweho, bityo umusanzu ntushobora kwandikwa mu bitabo. Saba ushinzwe ibaruramari kongeramo icyiciro.

contributionErrors.amount: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ukoresheje imibare gusa.
contributionErrors.categoryId: Hitamo icyiciro cy'amafaranga yinjira ayo amafaranga arimo.

apiErrors.nationalIdTaken: Undi munyamuryango asanzwe yanditswe kuri iyo nimero y'indangamuntu.

ledger.title: Imisanzu
ledger.description: Imisanzu yose koperative yakiriye, iheruka ibanza.
ledger.caption: Imisanzu ya koperative yose, hamwe n'umunyamuryango, itariki, umubare n'uko yishyuwe.
ledger.cancelConsequence: Umusanzu uguma mu nyandiko, kandi mu bitabo bya koperative handikwa igikosora kingana na wo ku buryo amafaranga asigaye asubira uko yari. Nta kintu gisibwa.
ledger.reasonHint: Umurongo umwe, urugero: yanditswe kabiri mu makosa.
ledger.emptyBody: Umusanzu wandikwa ku rupapuro rw'umunyamuryango, hanyuma ugaragara hano ako kanya.
ledger.emptyFilteredBody: Agura igihe cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe kugira ngo urebe ibindi.
